snippet.title: Ascend - Official Release Date Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2025
snippet.description:
Ascend is an adventure puzzle game where a young woman must navigate to the top of a mystical mountain learning the secrets of both the past and the future to find the balance in all aspects of life.
Ascend will be releasing August 28th. Visit Steam to add the game to your wishlist and download the demo!
